name: au.com.unicornlab/storefront
title: Unicorn Lab Nail Supply
description: Browse Unicorn Lab cuticle oils and nail supplies, check AU/NZ/UK/CA pricing, and build carts.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Unicorn Lab's live catalogue for scented cuticle oils, pens, refill pouches, nail decals, tools, and packs, with live AU/NZ/UK/CA pricing and variant URLs.

query.description: Search keywords (e.g. 'naked cuticle oil', 'bubblegum 15ml', 'refill pouch', 'waterslide decals').

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (1-10, default 5).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code; defaults to the country's local currency.

available_only.description: When true (default), return only products currently available for purchase.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Retrieve complete product details, variants, sizes, SKU codes, live AU/NZ/UK/CA pricing, and cart-ready variant IDs by product handle (e.g. 'bubblegum-unicorn-cuticle-oil') or Shopify Product GID.

id.description: Shopify Product GID ('gid://shopify/Product/11364748556'), numeric product ID, or product URL handle (e.g. 'naked-unicorn-cuticle-oil-unscented').

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code; defaults to the country's local currency.

tools.name: lookup_products
tools.description: Resolve 1 to 10 Unicorn Lab products by their Shopify Product GIDs in a single call with live AU/NZ/UK/CA pricing and stock status.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code; defaults to the country's local currency.

tools.name: ask_store_assistant
tools.description: Ask general questions about Unicorn Lab's cuticle oil collection, scent profiles, Australian manufacturing, dispatch, and storefront ordering.

question.description: Natural language question for Unicorn Lab's store assistant.

tools.name: search_policies_and_faqs
tools.description: Retrieve Unicorn Lab's official written store policies and FAQs including domestic/international shipping, returns, privacy policy, terms of service, and contact details.

query.description: Question or topic (e.g. 'shipping timeframes to New Zealand', 'refund policy', 'dispatch time').

policy_types.description: Optional specific policies to return in full.

tools.name: build_cart_link
tools.description: Create a verified Unicorn Lab Shopify cart permalink for the selected variant IDs and quantities so the buyer can review items and complete checkout in their browser.

variant_id.description: Numeric Shopify Variant ID (e.g. '47918151336158') or GID ('gid://shopify/ProductVariant/47918151336158').

items.description: Line items to include in the cart permalink.

country.description: Market country parameter for checkout currency/region.
